description: Temporary competitive default White-Spark priorities for the Grand Live CM19-CM22 window (September-December 2026). It intentionally specializes the four expected competitive profile pairs Turf/Medium (CM19), Turf/Long (CM20), Turf/Sprint (CM21), and Dirt/Mile (CM22) using exact-course mechanics plus probable Standard-deck access as a light-to-moderate scarcity signal. Gameplay and mechanical compatibility are evaluated first: an incompatible or badly timed skill stays low regardless of rarity. Direct hints on expected meta supports never make a defining skill guaranteed and therefore only lightly/moderately discount inheritance; reliable White/Gold support chains may discount more, but core skills are not zeroed. Outside those four profile pairs, the July 2026 / Grand Live generic baseline is retained. Values represent the strategic value of obtaining a skill as a White Spark, not raw in-race strength. No separate rarity multiplier is applied. This default is deliberately time-bounded and should be reworked after CM22.
